title: Waypoint Primer: condensed quick-entry hero, flow diagrams, and step choreography
creator: Maya Hirsh
description: Design a compact, scannable hero and accompanying flow diagrams for the Quickstart landing that reduce cognitive load for first-time integrators while preserving key product scaffolding (hosted/dedicated/private). Focus deliverables on a single hero composition that adapts to three breakpoints, a modular step-choreography system for progressive disclosure, and a lightweight diagram set that communicates routing and deployment choices. Outputs: Figma master file with tokens, responsive artboards, SVG diagrams exported and annotated, a set of motion micro-specs for step transitions, and a short handoff pack for Docs and Marketing.
acceptance_criteria: Hero art compresses to single-column at <=420px without loss of CTA prominence
Diagram set explains routing/policy fallback in 3 frames with accessible labels
Step choreography demonstrates 3-step progressive reveal with motion specs (duration, easing) and a reduce-motion variant
Figma file contains tokens and named variants; exported assets match asset naming convention
Copy and screenshots synced with Docs staging and validated by PM
